descriptor_hash_semantics: SHA-256 over u64be(len(descriptor-hash-profile)), exact profile UTF-8, u64be(len(descriptor JSON)), and the exact minified encoding/json bytes emitted from this ordered map-free descriptor struct in declared field order.
binding_hash_semantics: Streaming SHA-256 over the fixed field order in binding_encoding. It binds the descriptor identity, opaque document anchor, selected asset/font identities, every TextSource scalar, all frozen profiles, the three replayed identities and actual/upper byte counts, statuses, and portable resource charges. BindingHash itself is excluded.
binding_encoding: str is u64be UTF-8 byte length followed by exact bytes; u16/u32/u64 are unsigned big-endian and i64 is its two's-complement u64 bit pattern. Order: binding profile, receipt profile, source profile, descriptor-hash profile, descriptor hash, document-hash profile, document hash, schema u32, document canonical bytes, asset ID/kind/content hash, asset index, text/evaluator profiles, font ID/kind/hash, font/run/layout/outline/raster/paint/coverage profiles, font index, font-size numerator/denominator, line-height numerator/denominator, viewport width/height, fill RGBA u16, language/script/direction/alignment, Unicode version/validation profile/hash profile/table hash, source hash profile/hash, semantic hash profile/hash, layout hash profile/hash, binding profile, binding status, capability status, source actual/upper bytes, semantic actual/upper bytes, layout actual/upper bytes, text bytes, binding canonical bytes, total canonical bytes, work, working, retained. Raw text is committed by canonical source hash and is not duplicated verbatim in the binding preimage; its exact UTF-8 byte length is bound as text bytes.
source_binding_semantics: BindTextSource accepts one exact asset ID and index, resolves it in O(1) through the aligned compact slot table to a dense private scalar record, then live-checks the record asset index/ID, public SnapshotAsset metadata, text kind/profile, pinned font ID/index/kind/content hash, frozen profile set, and private binding hash before publication. Snapshots without v2 text retain neither slots nor records.
document_binding_semantics: DocumentHash is the opaque canonical CompileSnapshot trust anchor retained by FrozenSnapshot. A single FrozenTextSource view does not expose the Document bytes and is not independent proof of the complete Document.
canonical_replay_semantics: CompileSnapshot and BindTextSource call the same identity helper. It rebuilds a local TextSource and the semantic/layout envelopes, encodes all three with videoedit.CanonicalJSON, and checks their exact byte counts and SHA-256 identities against the private record and SnapshotAsset metadata.
ownership_semantics: The dense private record and successful FrozenTextSource contain scalar value fields only. Publication clones every dynamic string and exposes only value getters and a scalar receipt; no snapshot pointer, TextSource pointer, raw bytes, reader, slice, map, or backing store is exposed.
receipt_semantics: A serialized FrozenTextSourceReceipt and its public SHA-256 binding are unsigned structural evidence and never authority. Only a live opaque *FrozenTextSource returned by a successful BindTextSource call authorizes downstream use.
resource_semantics: All arithmetic is checked uint64. TextBytes=len UTF-8 text. CanonicalBinaryBytes=source actual+semantic actual+layout actual+binding canonical. WorkUnits=CanonicalBinaryBytes+TextBytes. WorkingBytes=65536+3*(source upper+semantic upper+layout upper)+binding canonical. WorkingBytes is an exact portable logical admission charge for the three sequential CanonicalJSON replay stages, not an allocator/RSS upper-bound guarantee. RetainedBytes=2048+2*sum of UTF-8 byte lengths for this exact retained string set: documentHash, assetID, assetKind, assetContentHash, textProfile, evaluatorProfile, text, fontAssetID, fontAssetKind, fontContentHash, fontProfile, runInputProfile, layoutProfile, outlineProfile, rasterProfile, paintProfile, coverageHashProfile, language, script, direction, alignment, unicodeVersion, unicodeValidationProfile, unicodeValidationHashProfile, unicodeValidationTableHash, canonicalSourceHashProfile, canonicalSourceHash, textSemanticHashProfile, textSemanticHash, layoutInputHashProfile, layoutInputHash, bindingHashProfile, receiptProfile, sourceProfile, descriptorHashProfile, descriptorHash, documentHashProfile, bindingStatus, capabilityStatus, bindingHash. Before canonical replay, exact stored charges and checked JSON 6*n+2 upper counts are admitted; actual encoded counts are checked again after replay.
cancellation_semantics: A non-nil context is checked before validation, during private hashing, around every canonical replay, and immediately before publication. Cancellation returns a nil source and zero receipt.
failure_semantics: Invalid selection, drifted metadata or private lineage, canonical mismatch, resource overflow, cancellation, and unexpected panic fail closed with a nil source and zero receipt; unexpected panic is classified as an invariant failure.
capability_semantics: This view authorizes access only to one frozen TextSource input and its pinned font identity. It does not attest font bytes, shaping output, layout, outlines, coverage, pixels, or a complete Document.
